_comment: Claude Code MCP server template. Copy to one of:
For Anthropic Remote Routines, MCP servers are configured at
https://claude.ai/customize/connectors — this file is for local Claude Code only.
All HTTP MCP servers require per-account auth. The transport handles auth via
OAuth (claude.ai connector) or a service-account token (manual setup). See
providers/claude-code.md for the full bootstrap flow.

pipedream._comment: Gmail (read/send), Google Calendar (read), Google Drive (read). Auth is per-account via Pipedream Connect — sign in once at pipedream.com and authorize the underlying Google apps.

atlassian._comment: Jira + Confluence (read-only here; write tools are deny-listed in .claude/settings.json). The first call to getAccessibleAtlassianResources discovers your cloudId; cache it in state.json > cached.atlassian_cloud_id.

aws._comment: S3 (state pull/push) + Secrets Manager (runtime secrets). Uses your local AWS credentials chain (env, ~/.aws/credentials, IAM role). For Anthropic routines, connect the AWS MCP at claude.ai/customize/connectors instead; that server uses a routine-scoped IAM principal.
